description: How open interest (total open positions) in a market changed over time, in coins and USD. Rising OI with rising price usually means new longs; falling OI means positions are closing. Default: hourly for the last 24h.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

name: hydromancer_open_interest_history
title: Open interest history
